name: drilldownLabel
label: Drill down label
description: Text visible at the tooltip to help user understand what will happen on click.

name: showClosestSeriesOnHover
label: Show only one data point in tooltip
description: When turned on, shows only the selected data point. When off, shows all data points. Treated as on when zoomed in 400% or higher.

name: chartSize
label: Chart size
description: Sets the size of the chart.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: When selected, enables an event handler to allow users to click a visualization value or section.

name: chartExtraConfig
label: Extra Chart Config
description: additional chart configuration

name: showForecast
label: Show forecast
description: Displays forecast data in the chart based on current trend data.

name: showForecastRange
label: Show forecast range
description: Displays the 95% confidence interval of the forecast.

name: showTarget
label: Show target
description: Displays the global target value. Target will only appear if it is defined for the indicator.

name: showTrend
label: Show trend
description: Displays the direction the indicator is moving, or how values have changed over time.

name: showConfidenceBand
label: Show confidence band
description: Displays the bandwidth between which indicator scores are moving.

name: showThreshold
label: Show threshold
description: Displays an active threshold set for the selected indicator, such as an all-time high or low. Thresholds appear only if they have been defined for the selected indicator.

name: showComment
label: Show comment
description: Displays comments added to data points.

name: showDataTable
label: Show data table
description: Shows a table with chart and graph data for easier screen reader access.

name: lineStrokeWidth
label: Line stroke width
description: Sets the line stroke width for the items on the chart in pixels.

name: yAxisStyle
label: Axis style
description: Style of the Y axis. Clean - Hides Y axis line, keeping just axis values. No tick lines - Removes all tick marks from the Y axis. Standard - Adds a line and tick marks to the Y axis.

name: hideYAxis0
label: Hide primary axis
description: Hides the vertical axis.

name: yAxis0Title
label: Y Axis Title
description: Title to display on the vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis0From
label: Y Axis From
description: Starting point for the range of values for the vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis0To
label: Y Axis To
description: Ending point for the range of values for the vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis0Position
label: Y Axis To
description: Position of the primary axis.

name: hideYAxis1
label: Hide secondary axis
description: Hides the secondary vertical axis.

name: yAxis1Title
label: Y Axis Title
description: Title to display on the secondary vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis1From
label: Y Axis From
description: Starting point for the range of values for the secondary vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis1To
label: Y Axis To
description: Ending point for the range of values for the secondary vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis1Position
label: Y Axis To
description: Position of the secondary axis.

name: hideYAxis2
label: Hide tertiary axis
description: Hides the tertiary vertical axis.

name: yAxis2Title
label: Y Axis Title
description: Title to display on the tertiary vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis2From
label: Y Axis From
description: Starting point for the range of values for the tertiary vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis2To
label: Y Axis To
description: Ending point for the range of values for the tertiary vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis2Position
label: Y Axis To
description: Position of the tertiary axis.

name: hideYAxis3
label: Hide axis 4
description: Hides the 4th vertical axis.

name: yAxis3Title
label: Y Axis Title
description: Title to display on the 4th vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis3From
label: Y Axis From
description: Starting point for the range of values for the 4th vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis3To
label: Y Axis To
description: Ending point for the range of values for the 4th vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis3Position
label: Y Axis To
description: Position of the 4th axis.

name: hideYAxis4
label: Hide axis 5
description: Hides the 5th vertical axis.

name: yAxis4Title
label: Y Axis Title
description: Title to display on the 5th vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis4From
label: Y Axis From
description: Starting point for the range of values for the 5th vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis4To
label: Y Axis To
description: Ending point for the range of values for the 5th vertical axis of the visualization.

name: yAxis4Position
label: Y Axis To
description: Position of the 5th axis.

name: xAxisTitle
label: X Axis Title
description: Title to display on the horizontal axis of the visualization.

name: showXGrid
label: Show grid
description: Adds grid lines to the chart.

name: showYGrid
label: Show grid
description: Adds grid lines to the chart.

name: showLegend
label: Show legend
description: Toggles the display of the legend on the visualization.

name: showLegendValue
label: Show legend value
description: Displays the value corresponding to the area of the chart you hover on. The value displays as a tooltip and in the chart legend.

name: legendPosition
label: Legend position
description: Legend location relative to the chart.

name: legendHorizontalAlignment
label: Horizontal alignment
description: Horizontal alignment of elements in the legend.

name: legendMaxItemWidth
label: Max legend item width, px
description: Defines number of pixels after which the item of the legend will be truncated.

name: legendExpandToFit
label: Expand legend vertically
description: When enabled the legend will takes as much space as needed to fit legend without scrolling instead of maximum 2 lines.

name: showDataLabels
label: Show data labels
description: Displays the score for each data point.

name: dataLabelPosition
label: Data label position
description: Display data labels above, at the top, middle, or bottom of the bars.

name: showOverlappingLabels
label: Show overlapping labels
description: Display values that overlap.

name: showMaximumRange
label: Show maximum range
description: Shows the maximum range of available dates.

name: disableTooltip
label: Disable tooltip
description: Removes tooltips on hover.

name: showContinuousLine
label: Show continuous line
description: When there is no data for a specific time, there will be no gap in the chart and it shows continuous line.

name: showMarkers
label: Show markers
description: Displays a symbol at each data point on the chart, including when values are zero or missing, making it easier to identify specific values.

name: numberOfPeriods
label: Number of periods
description: Number of date periods to display.

name: startTime
label: Start time
description: Start date for the absolute period.

name: followFilters
label: Follow filters
description: Follow filters set for a page. When enabled, the visualization displays on a workspace with the filters set by the page. Toggle off to disable a visualization from accepting any filter input.

name: chartVariation
label: Chart variation
description: Specifies the style of the bars.

name: period
label: Period
description: Time interval for each date period.

name: headerTitle
label: Chart title
description: Title for the visualization.

name: showPercentageOfTotalInTooltip
label: Show % of total in tooltip
description: Displays the percentage each data point contributes to the total. When enabled, percentages are shown alongside absolute values in the tooltip.

name: enableAddZerosAtApi
label: Show 0 when no data available
description: Choose the display format when there is no value in the selected dataset or for the configuration.
